notes.title: Pulse Check: Still alive
notes.content:
Hey everyone I just wanted to make sure you knew we are still alive and kicking.
Since the announcement a variety of features have been implemented to enhance user experience.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweeter Profile Picture Selection
[*] Custom Profile Pictures just add them to the ProfilePics folder where your game is storing user data 
[*] New Difficulties so you can customize your experience
[*] Create helper "Applications" called Rules.exe and Categories.exe to make your job easier (especially if you skipped the tutorial)
[*] implemented a variety other features tied to the nature of the game
[*] Music was finished and you can hear a sample [url=https://x.com/jawolzgaming/status/1799477037280940399]here[/url]
[/list]
[h2]How to add Custom Profile Pics[/h2]
(windows is %appdata%/cortico) and they will appear in the game. Must be .png, the game will autoscale the images to 64x64

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031654/c055806dd5be26419be69888443f25a4c2e3af51.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031654/baacebd610741df49446d03b9289c6980571c563.png[/img]

[h2]Helper Applications[/h2]

[h3]rules.exe [/h3]
Gives you the run down of everything you'll need to remember to be successful

[h3]Categories.exe[/h3]
Gives a comprehensive list of where the icons are supposed to go. NO MORE AMBIGUITY.

These can be accessed from the desktop in the lab

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031654/7b98b681d43466712c2262db916d1e38748351d4.png[/img]



[h2]Difficulties [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031654/c8606e5313f3c27df683cdffa62a7c99447f0d49.png[/img]

There are 3 difficulties
[list]
[*] Novel - There is no minimum quota. Categories are randomly sorted. 
[*] Normal - Small minimum quota. Categories are semi-randomly sorted.  Confidence meter has more options to fail.
[*] Game - Large minimum quota. Categories are sorted in a way to cause the most trip ups. Confidence has more options to fail that closely resemble success.
[/list]
